conclusion: During the 20s cut, CP refused 50.7% of requests with 0 stale reads, while AP answered 100% but gave 241 stale reads and accepted 1 withdrawals a serial bank refused (ledger low -135); merging logs at repair left a balance error of 0, while last-writer-wins dropped 94 writes and left it off by 668.
setup: simulated 2-replica account (Europe, Asia), seed 7, 60s at 20 req/s, cut 20s to 40s, start balance 1000, mix read/deposit/withdraw 0.5/0.25/0.25, amounts 5 to 25 precomputed, one scripted withdrawal of 700 on each side at 30s, CP majority (with witness) in Europe, AP repaired two ways: per-replica log merge, and last-writer-wins on balance
note: Saved from the RESULT line of run.mjs (the lab itself writes no files).
